name: Belvidere Park District (Belvidere Township Park District), IL
fy_label_rule: fiscal year is the calendar year (FY2027 = January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2027); audits are 'for the year ended December 31'
legal_name_note: Older documents (FY2023-24 ordinances and budgets) are headed 'Belvidere Township Park District'; the website and recent documents say 'Belvidere Park District'. Illinois Comptroller unit code 004/010/12.

funds.name: Riverfront (seen in the FY2020 budget only)

account_format.pattern: FF-DDDD-OOO in FY2023-FY2025 documents (fund-department-object, e.g. 01-0100-310); FF-DDD-OOOO in the FY2027 draft (e.g. 01-010-3010). Period of the change and the code mapping are still to be established (Phase 2).
account_format.key_note: provisional: department + object code within a fund; the two numbering schemes need a mapping table before years can be joined
